figures.Fig15.22: Electroencephalography. Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch15-fig-brain-tests (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The book links theta waves to deep sleep and delta waves to the deepest sleep 'and dreaming'; most sources link theta to drowsiness and light sleep, delta to deep dreamless sleep, and vivid dreaming to REM sleep. Noted in the lesson, flagged.
